title: Power Usage Tracking — Live Browser Re-Validation (clean runtime)
runtime: Docker (clean, stale process on 8080 terminated beforehand, Docker confirmed sole listener)
overall_status: PARTIAL — all core features pass, 2 functional bugs + 3 UX issues found

findings.title: Negative power value silently overwrites existing valid value with null — no user-visible validation error
findings.ac_violated: Given I enter a negative number or non-numeric value, when I try to save, then validation rejects it
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Set Power (W) to 150 and click SAVE CHANGES
3. Return to the same page, type -50 into Power (W)
findings.expected: Validation error shown; existing 150W value preserved
findings.actual: The browser number input's min=0 constraint silently clears -50 to empty, which is then saved as NULL — overwriting the existing valid 150W entry. No error message is shown to the user at any point. The field shows blank after the submit, with no indication anything went wrong.
findings.impact: Silent data loss: previously saved watt values are destroyed without warning when a user accidentally enters a negative number

findings.title: Map location drawer shows grammatically incorrect '1 devices' instead of '1 device'
findings.surface: Location detail drawer — power total line
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Click the HT008 Geo 16584a marker (location with 1 powered device)
3. Read the power summary line in the drawer
findings.impact: Minor copy/grammar issue visible to all users

findings.title: CLEAR button on Power Settings silently resets form only — does not persist; old values restored on reload without warning
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Save a valid electricity rate (e.g. 0.15 EUR)
2. Click CLEAR button — fields appear empty, Last updated timestamp unchanged
3. Reload page without clicking SAVE SETTINGS
findings.expected: CLEAR either: (a) immediately saves null values and shows a confirmation toast, OR (b) disables itself or clearly prompts the user to click SAVE SETTINGS to persist the clear
findings.actual: CLEAR only resets the form fields in the browser session. No toast fires, no API call is made. The stale 'Last updated' timestamp gives no indication the clear was not persisted. Reload brings old values back silently.
findings.impact: Confusing UX: users may believe the rate is cleared when it is not. This could cause phantom cost estimates to persist unexpectedly.

findings.title: Show Power toggle in Inventory is not persistent across page navigation
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Enable Show Power — Power (W) column appears
findings.expected: Toggle preference persisted (e.g. in localStorage) so Power (W) column stays visible across visits
findings.actual: Checkbox resets to unchecked on every page load; user must re-enable on each visit
findings.impact: Mild friction for users who rely on the power column

findings.title: Device edit page (/inventory/edit/{id}) has no Location field — location assignment requires topology canvas
findings.surface: Device edit form (fields: Name, Type, Status, IP, MAC, OS, Power (W), Notes)
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Observe form fields — no Location selector is present
findings.expected: Location dropdown on the dedicated device edit page for discoverability
findings.actual: Location can only be assigned or changed through the topology canvas side panel. Not accessible from the dedicated edit page. Power aggregation by location is therefore not testable end-to-end without knowing about the canvas panel.
findings.impact: Users editing devices from inventory cannot set location, which blocks location-based power aggregation for those devices. Dashboard shows 'No location power data yet' for correctly-configured devices whose location is not visible from the edit form.

non_bugs_confirmed.title: Float precision artifact in spinbutton accessibility attribute
non_bugs_confirmed.detail: The spinbutton shows value='0.15000000596046448' in a11y tree. This is a NiceGUI float32 rendering artifact. API GET /api/power/summary correctly returns cost_per_kwh: 0.15. Not a data issue.

non_bugs_confirmed.title: Device edit SAVE CHANGES feedback toast is present but brief
non_bugs_confirmed.detail: After SAVE CHANGES, a toast fires (confirmed by Playwright wait_for catching 'saved' within the 4s window). It auto-dismisses quickly. Not a missing-feedback bug.
